SELECT date(timestamp) AS day, count(JSONExtractFloat(payload, 'amount')) AS n FROM events WHERE date(timestamp) >= today() - 4 AND service = 'worker' AND message = 'processed' GROUP BY day

WITH pool AS (SELECT JSONExtractString(payload, 'id') AS event_id, JSONExtractString(payload, 'active') AS active, JSONExtractFloat(payload, 'amount') AS amount, date(timestamp) AS day FROM events WHERE date(timestamp) >= today() - 4 AND service = 'worker' AND message = 'processed') SELECT day, count(DISTINCT event_id) AS n FROM pool WHERE active = 'true' AND amount != 0 GROUP BY day ORDER BY day ASC

WITH pool AS (SELECT date(timestamp) AS day, sum(JSONExtractFloat(payload, 'amount')) / 10000000 AS n FROM events WHERE date(timestamp) >= today() - 4 AND service = 'worker' AND message = 'processed' GROUP BY day) SELECT * FROM pool
